15 - Verify all 6 social icons show in the correct order matching Figma (correct, no fix needed)
Order and identity confirmed via the Figma images API render (not guessed from vector paths): Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, TikTok, LinkedIn, Line -- live matches exactly, including icon color (#f2f2f2, matching Figma's fill exactly). Selector note: these links have no `aria-label` attribute at all (an initial selector assuming one would have silently matched nothing) -- the real accessible name comes from a `title` attribute ("<Store name> on <Platform>") plus a visually-hidden `.icon__fallback-text` span; matched here via the `.footer__social` container's link order instead. Also confirmed: each icon's `<path>` has a hardcoded `fill="#444"` SVG attribute, but a stylesheet rule overrides it via computed `fill` -- the ACTUAL rendered color is #f2f2f2 as expected, not the raw attribute value. Second selector note: an xpath `//path` against these SVG elements matches nothing (0 results) because `<path>` lives in the SVG XML namespace and an unprefixed XPath name test only matches no-namespace elements -- fixed by using a plain CSS selector for the path check instead (CSS is namespace-agnostic here), rather than `*[local-name()='path']`.
Passed ▼
